notes: Access: same as Bestsellers file - tier 1 direct HTTP blocked by Cloudflare 429 challenge, tier 2 Playwright/CDP headless Chromium succeeded after warming up on the homepage to clear the JS challenge; Claude-in-Chrome not needed. Discovery: grepped collections.json (372 collections) for clearance/outlet/sale/final-sale/last-chance/end-of-line/discontinued terms, and checked main nav 'SALE' mega menu plus footer sale links. Result: the site has NO page using the words Clearance, Outlet, Final Sale, Last Chance, or End of Line as its own title/H1 - every discount-style page is one of ~18 '*-sale' collections rolled up under nav item SALE -> /collections/sale ('The Big Spender Sale'). Opened /collections/sale directly: its own on-page/meta description explicitly states 'Our sale is a curated edit - not a clearance dump. Every piece is a genuine Freedom Tree design, reduced to make room for new collections.' - this is an explicit self-disclaimer against the Clearance concept, tied to a named recurring campaign ('Big Spender Sale' / 'End of Season Sale' per nav copy) rather than permanent outlet/markdown merchandising. Per the Sale-vs-Clearance test this is a generic temporary promotional sale and was EXCLUDED, along with its ~17 category-sliced siblings (furniture-sale, lighting-sale, home-decor-sale, dining-entertaining-sale, cushion-sale, curtains-sale, upholstery-sale, bedlinen-sale, clothing-sale, furnishing-sale, kitchen-table-linen-sale, new-on-sale, all-sale-products, all-skus-minus-sale, all-skus-minus-sale-minus-furniture, all-sku-minus-sale-funiture, all-furniture-minus-sale-furniture, sale-exlcuding-fabrics-excluding-furniture) which are all generic sub-slices/exclusion-sets of the same seasonal Big Spender Sale, none independently labelled clearance/outlet. One ambiguous candidate was found and is recorded per the brief's flag-don't-guess instruction: /collections/deep-discounts, reached from a link inside the /collections/sale page itself with anchor/list text 'Last Chance-Upto 50% off' (literally matching the target term 'Last Chance'). The Deep Discounts page itself is titled just 'Deep Discounts' with no clearance/outlet wording on-page, and its product tags reference 'BE_EOSS July 2025' (End-of-Season-Sale, a named seasonal campaign) and 'BE_SALE' - i.e. it reads as a deeper-markdown slice of the same seasonal sale ecosystem rather than a distinct permanent-outlet listing, but the literal 'Last Chance' copy pointing to it keeps it from being a clean exclude. Recorded with a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than silently dropped or silently included.

rows.evidence: Rendered collection page text '231 Products' (page title 'Deep Discounts'); confirmed exhaustively via /collections/deep-discounts/products.json?limit=250 = 231 unique product IDs on a single page (<250, no further pages). Reached via a link on /collections/sale with visible text 'Last Chance-Upto 50% off'.
rows.flag: MANUAL REVIEW: AMBIGUOUS SALE/CLEARANCE - page titled only 'Deep Discounts', product tags reference a named seasonal campaign (BE_EOSS July 2025 / BE_SALE), and the sitewide /collections/sale page explicitly says 'not a clearance dump' - but the nav copy linking to this exact page literally reads 'Last Chance-Upto 50% off', which matches the brief's target Clearance term. Could not confirm with certainty whether this is a genuine permanent-markdown clearance listing or just deeper-discount tier of the same seasonal sale.
